title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市应急指挥中心调度防汛工作 强调加强监测预警和应急处置确保人民群众生命财产安全
title_en: Hao Huijie Directs Flood Control Work at Municipal Emergency Command Center
summary_zh: 8月1日，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰在市应急指挥中心调度防汛工作，强调加强监测预警和应急处置，确保人民群众生命财产安全和社会大局稳定。
summary_en: On August 1, Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, directed flood control work at the Municipal Emergency Command Center, emphasizing enhanced monitoring, early warning, and emergency response to ensure public safety and social stability.
